Thanks Logan — looping in Jordan (FinOps) and Marissa (Vendor Ops) to finalize mapping and timeline. Quick notes:  

- We can accept both ACH and wire with the provided bank letter + voided check.
- For remittance routing, Redwood honors the "PO" and "InvoiceRef" fields; if you want the PO to drive routing, we'll map PO -> remit_tag (PO).
- We also ask for a short mapping spreadsheet with examples (PO value, invoice payload snippet) so our integrators can validate.

Jordan / Marissa — can you confirm: is a single PO column to remit_tag sufficient, or do we need the two-field approach (PO + customer_code)? If we get the mapping today we can schedule the first payout for 5/20 as requested, pending micro-deposit confirmation.

2) Send the mapping spreadsheet with 3 example rows (I've attached our template).
3) Confirm whether the finance team needs "invoiceDate" included in the remittance payload (most customers do not require it).

Attachments: [Attachment: po-field-mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]
